description: A four-panel (2×2) composite of TEM dark-field (DF) micrographs of ferrite in Fe–28Mn–9Al-1.2C-xCr strips annealed at 550 °C for 5 h. Every panel carries a white 500 nm scale bar, the yellow phase label "δ+DO3", and a selected-area diffraction pattern (SADP) inset at top right. (a) 0Cr strip, DF imaged with a reflection along (1̄10)δ; the SADP is indexed [001]δ+[001]DO3 with reflections labelled (200), (220), (110), (000), (020); the DF contrast is broad, wavy, irregular bright bands. (b) 3Cr strip, DF imaged along (1̄10)δ; SADP indexed [011]δ+[011]DO3 with (2̄11), (200), (011), (000), (1̄11), (2̄00), (1̄11), (111), giving angular, blocky bright grains. (c) 6Cr strip, DF imaged along (200)_DO3; SADP again indexed [011]δ+[011]DO3; a cigar/teardrop-shaped region filled with fine equiaxed grains. (d) 9Cr strip, DF imaged along (200)_DO3; SADP indexed [011]δ+[011]DO3; a broad oval region of fine, mottled grains. The figure demonstrates that after annealing at 550 °C for 5 h, DO3 superlattice reflections — and hence δ+DO3 ordered ferrite domains — are present in all four strips, including 0Cr and 3Cr.

subfigures.description: TEM dark-field image of 0Cr strip, 500 nm scale bar, yellow label 'δ+DO3'. Inset SADP indexed [001]δ+[001]DO3 with labelled reflections (200), (220), (110), (000), (020). DF contrast: broad wavy, irregular bright bands.

TEM dark-field image of 3Cr strip, 500 nm scale bar, yellow label 'δ+DO3'. Inset SADP indexed [011]δ+[011]DO3 with labelled reflections (2̄11), (200), (011), (000), (1̄11), (2̄00), (1̄11), (111). DF contrast: angular, blocky bright grains on a dark matrix.

TEM dark-field image of 6Cr strip, 500 nm scale bar, yellow label 'δ+DO3'. Inset SADP indexed [011]δ+[011]DO3 with reflections (2̄11), (200), (011), (000), (1̄11), (2̄00), (111). DF contrast: cigar/teardrop-shaped region of finer equiaxed grains.

TEM dark-field image of 9Cr strip, 500 nm scale bar, yellow label 'δ+DO3'. Inset SADP indexed [011]δ+[011]DO3 with reflections (200), (2̄11), (1̄11), (000), (011), (111), (2̄00). DF contrast: broad oval region of fine, mottled grains with a smooth rim.

observations.observation: The figure is a 2×2 composite in which all four panels are TEM dark-field micrographs, each with a selected-area diffraction pattern inset at top right, a white '500 nm' scale bar at bottom left and the yellow phase label 'δ+DO3'.
The SADP inset of panel (a) (0Cr) is labelled [001]δ+[001]DO3 and its reflections are indexed (200), (220), (110), (000) and (020).
The SADP insets of panels (b), (c) and (d) are all labelled [011]δ+[011]DO3 and share the reflection set (2̄11), (200), (011), (000), (1̄11), (2̄00), (1̄11)/(111).

Dark-field contrast morphology differs between panels: (a) shows broad wavy irregular bright bands, (b) angular blocky grains, (c) a cigar/teardrop-shaped region of fine grains and (d) a broad oval region of fine mottled grains.

The caption states the four panels are DF images of the 0Cr, 3Cr, 6Cr and 9Cr strips annealed at 550 °C for 5 h, imaged with a reflection along (1̄10)δ for (a) and (b) and along (200)_DO3 for (c) and (d).
The caption states each DF image is accompanied by its corresponding SADP, i.e. the diffraction patterns are the origin of the dark-field reflections used.

Caption and pixels appear to disagree for panel (a): the caption says the DF image was taken along (1̄10)δ, whereas the visible SADP inset of (a) is indexed [001]δ+[001]DO3; both readings are reported and the discrepancy is unresolved.
The citing text states that after annealing at 550 °C for 5 h the superlattice belonging to the DO3 phase appears in all annealed strips, including 0Cr and 3Cr, as shown in Fig. 10.

The citing text states that Fig. 9 presents TEM results for austenite and Fig. 10 for ferrite, and that TEM was conducted on annealed Fe–28Mn–9Al-1.2C-xCr strips to correlate microstructure with mechanical properties.
The yellow text 'δ+DO3' is overprinted on every DF image, indicating that the imaged regions are δ-ferrite containing DO3-ordered phase.
No numeric values other than the 500 nm scale bars and crystallographic indices are printed on any panel; no composition or property values appear in the figure.

measured_quantities: scale bar length (nm), 500 nm in each panel
unreadable_items: Panel (a): caption states imaging along (1̄10)δ but the SADP inset is labelled [001]δ+[001]DO3 — indexing/imaging-direction mismatch not resolvable from the image
Reflection indices inside the small SADP insets (especially the faint outer spots) are only partially legible at the supplied resolution
